dedupe_keys.name: african mining governance infrastructure and open deposit register afrimintel v1 1

description: This dataset records what mining governance information 40 African jurisdictions publish and on what terms, plus an open register of 83 mineral deposits with screening-grade coordinates. The Zenodo record says 28 jurisdictions publish a public mining tenure register, 24 of them portal-only with only 4 offering bulk export, three registers were not fetched because of restrictive terms (Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire and South Africa), none states an open reuse grant, and 24 jurisdictions take part in the ICGLR, Kimberley Process or iTSCi traceability schemes. Each value is marked Sourced, Derived or Absent. It was published by Nikesh Patel of the company Afrimintel Ltd, Mauritius (version 1.1, September 2026) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as CSV and JSON with a README, and corrections are logged publicly. Coverage is Africa. Caveats: deposit coordinates are for screening only, per-row read dates are still pending, and v1.1 corrected several v1.0 errors. For simulation it gives jurisdiction data access and deposit locations to scope African mineral supply chain and governance risk studies. Related catalogue records include the USGS global critical minerals mines, deposits and districts data and the operating mines of South Africa.
